missions.title: Market Explorer
missions.topic: Count and check · there is and there are
missions.subtitle: Read the market clues
missions.guide: Read the list. Tap the word block that matches the supplies!
missions.reminder: Match the words to the number. One item needs is; two or more need are.

tasks.prompt: Market list: one jacket, two caps. There ___ two caps.
tasks.hint: The clue says two caps. Choose the words for more than one.
tasks.explain: There are matches two caps. There is would describe one cap.

tasks.prompt: Market list: three hats, no shoes. Are there any shoes? No, there ___.
tasks.hint: Read the shoes part of the list. There are no shoes.
tasks.explain: No, there aren't matches the question and the empty shoes list.

tasks.prompt: Only one parrot is in the tower. Complete the yes-or-no question: ___ a parrot in the tower?
tasks.full: Is there a parrot in the tower?
tasks.hint: The question is about one parrot. Start with Is there.
tasks.explain: Is there a parrot? asks whether one parrot is there.

tasks.prompt: Room list: one robot, four cars. How many cars are there? There are ___.
tasks.hint: Count the cars, not the robot.
tasks.explain: How many cars? asks for the car count. The list has four cars.

tasks.prompt: Box list: two books and one map. ___ a map in the box.
tasks.full: There's a map in the box.
tasks.hint: The map is one item. Choose the words for one.
tasks.explain: There's means There is. It matches one map.

missions.title: Routine Bridge
missions.topic: Do you? · read a weekly plan
missions.subtitle: Ask the right routine question
missions.guide: Read the plan. Tap an answer that matches the day and activity!
missions.reminder: Read the whole clue before answering. Do you? uses Yes, I do or No, I don't.

tasks.prompt: Sara: I ride a bike on Sundays. Do you ride a bike on Sundays, Sara? ___
tasks.hint: Sara rides a bike on Sundays. The question starts with Do you.
tasks.explain: Yes, I do matches both the routine and the Do you question.

tasks.prompt: Dan: I play tennis on Saturdays. I do not play tennis on Mondays. Do you play tennis on Mondays, Dan? ___
tasks.hint: Check Monday, not Saturday.
tasks.explain: No, I don't matches Dan's Monday routine.

tasks.prompt: Mia: I watch TV on Fridays. Ask Mia about her Friday routine: ___ you watch TV on Fridays?
tasks.full: Do you watch TV on Fridays?
tasks.hint: Use Do you to ask about this free-time routine.
tasks.explain: Do you watch TV on Fridays? asks about Mia's weekly activity.

tasks.prompt: Ali: I read a book on Tuesdays. Do you read a book on Tuesdays, Ali? Yes, I ___.
tasks.hint: Match Do you with Yes, I do.
tasks.explain: Yes, I do confirms that reading is Ali's Tuesday activity.

tasks.prompt: Tim: I ride a bike at the weekend. I do not watch TV at the weekend. Do you watch TV at the weekend, Tim? No, I ___.
tasks.hint: Check the TV clue, not the bike clue.
tasks.explain: No, I don't matches the activity in the question.

missions.title: Weekly-plan Train
missions.subtitle: Turn clues into a plan
missions.guide: Tap the word carriages in order. Turn each plan into a sentence!
missions.reminder: Use on with days, such as Mondays. Use at in at the weekend.

tasks.prompt: Your plan says: tennis, every Monday. Tell a friend. Start with I.
tasks.hint: Begin I play. Put the day after on.
tasks.explain: I play tennis on Mondays gives the activity and the repeated day.

tasks.prompt: You read a book each Friday. Tell a friend when. Start with I.
tasks.answer: I read a book on Fridays.
tasks.full: I read a book on Fridays.
tasks.hint: Begin I read. Put on Fridays at the end.
tasks.explain: On Fridays tells your friend which day this happens.

tasks.prompt: Every Sunday is your bike day. Tell a friend your routine. Start with I.
tasks.answer: I ride a bike on Sundays.
tasks.full: I ride a bike on Sundays.
tasks.hint: Begin I ride. Put the activity before the day.
tasks.explain: I ride a bike on Sundays turns the weekly plan into a sentence.

tasks.prompt: The piano is your activity every Saturday. Make your sentence. Start with I.
tasks.answer: I play the piano on Saturdays.
tasks.full: I play the piano on Saturdays.
tasks.hint: Begin I play. Keep the piano together.
tasks.explain: I play the piano on Saturdays gives the activity and the day.

tasks.prompt: Your weekend activity is watching TV. Tell a friend. Start with I.
tasks.answer: I watch TV at the weekend.
tasks.full: I watch TV at the weekend.
tasks.hint: Begin I watch TV. Finish with at the weekend.
tasks.explain: At the weekend tells us when you watch TV.

missions.title: Clothes-check River
missions.subtitle: Read clothes clues
missions.guide: Put the word blocks in order. Describe or check the clothes!
missions.reminder: Describe clothes with is wearing. Start a clothes question with Is he or Is she.

tasks.prompt: Amir has a red cap on his head. Describe what he is wearing. Start with Amir.
tasks.answer: Amir is wearing a red cap.
tasks.full: Amir is wearing a red cap.
tasks.hint: Begin Amir is wearing. Put the colour before cap.
tasks.explain: Amir is wearing a red cap describes the clothes in the clue.

tasks.prompt: Nia is a girl with a green skirt on. Describe her clothes. Start with She.
tasks.answer: She is wearing a green skirt.
tasks.full: She is wearing a green skirt.
tasks.hint: She replaces Nia. Begin She is wearing.
tasks.explain: She is wearing a green skirt describes Nia's clothes.

tasks.prompt: Dan is a boy with blue shoes on his feet. Describe his clothes. Start with He.
tasks.hint: He replaces Dan. Begin He is wearing.
tasks.explain: He is wearing blue shoes describes Dan's clothes.

tasks.prompt: Ben is a boy. You want to check if his T-shirt is blue. Build a question. Start with Is.
tasks.answer: Is he wearing a blue T-shirt?
tasks.full: Is he wearing a blue T-shirt?
tasks.hint: Begin Is he wearing. Finish the question with a blue T-shirt?
tasks.explain: Is he wearing a blue T-shirt? asks someone to check Ben's clothes.

tasks.prompt: Mia is a girl. You want to check if she has a warm jacket on. Build a question. Start with Is.
tasks.answer: Is she wearing a warm jacket?
tasks.full: Is she wearing a warm jacket?
tasks.hint: Begin Is she wearing. Finish with a warm jacket?
tasks.explain: Is she wearing a warm jacket? asks someone to check Mia's clothes.

missions.title: Robot Ability Mine
missions.topic: can · can't · check the skill card
missions.subtitle: Match skills to the clue
missions.guide: Read the skill card. Tap the answer that matches the ability!
missions.reminder: Check the activity in the question. Can means able; can't means not able.

tasks.prompt: Robot card: swim yes; fly no. The robot ___ swim.
tasks.hint: Read the swim part of the card.
tasks.explain: The robot can swim matches swim yes.

tasks.prompt: Mia: I can run. I can't skip. Can you skip, Mia? ___
tasks.hint: The question asks about skipping, not running.
tasks.explain: No, I can't matches Mia's skipping ability.

tasks.prompt: Amir: I can dance. I can't fly. Amir ___ dance.
tasks.hint: Choose the words for the dance clue.
tasks.explain: Amir can dance matches the first part of his skill card.

tasks.prompt: Nia is a girl. Her card says: jump yes; swim no. She ___ swim.
tasks.hint: Check swim, not jump.
tasks.explain: She can't swim matches swim no.

tasks.prompt: Ben: I can stand on one leg. Ask Ben about this ability: ___ you stand on one leg?
tasks.full: Can you stand on one leg?
tasks.hint: Start an ability question with Can you.
tasks.explain: Can you stand on one leg? asks about Ben's ability.

missions.title: Clothes-choice Portal
missions.subtitle: Check the clothes together
missions.guide: Tap a word portal. Check the item, colour and reply!
missions.reminder: Use this for one item and these for more than one. Check colours before you reply.

tasks.prompt: Shop labels: one cap, two socks. Ask about the cap: Do you like ___ cap?
tasks.hint: The cap is one item.
tasks.explain: This cap matches the one cap on the shop list.

tasks.prompt: Shop labels: one cap, two socks. Ask about the socks: Do you like ___ socks?
tasks.hint: The socks are more than one item.
tasks.explain: These socks matches the two socks on the shop list.

tasks.prompt: Amir has a green jacket on. Is he wearing a blue jacket? ___
tasks.hint: The question says blue. The clue says green.
tasks.explain: No, he isn't is the reply because Amir's jacket is green.

tasks.prompt: Hana has a red skirt on. Is she wearing a red skirt? Yes, she ___.
tasks.hint: The colour and the clothing both match.
tasks.explain: Yes, she is confirms the clothes in the clue.

tasks.prompt: Mia: I like this cap. I do not like these shoes. Do you like these shoes, Mia? ___
tasks.hint: Read the shoes clue. The question is not about the cap.
tasks.explain: No, I don't matches how Mia feels about the shoes.

missions.title: Lost-item Hideout
missions.topic: Where's? · Where are? · match the place
missions.subtitle: Find things from a list
missions.guide: Read both clues. Tap the words that find the right item!
missions.reminder: One item uses Where's and It's. More than one uses Where are and They're.

tasks.prompt: Bag list: one book and two caps. Ask about the book: ___ the book?
tasks.hint: The book is one item.
tasks.explain: Where's the book? asks about the place of the one book.

tasks.prompt: Bag list: one book and two caps. Ask about the caps: ___ the caps?
tasks.hint: The caps are more than one item.
tasks.explain: Where are the caps? asks about the place of the two caps.

tasks.prompt: One blue book is in a red bag. Two green books are in a black bag. Where's the blue book? ___
tasks.hint: Find the blue book. There is only one blue book.
tasks.explain: It's in the red bag uses It's for one book and matches its bag.

tasks.prompt: One red cap is in a green box. Two red shoes are in a blue bag. Where are the shoes? ___
tasks.hint: Find the shoes. Use the words for more than one.
tasks.explain: They're in the blue bag matches both the two shoes and their place.

tasks.prompt: One map is in the bag. Where's the map? ___ in the bag.
tasks.hint: Answer about the one map.
tasks.explain: It's in the bag uses It for the one map.

missions.title: Beach-plan Castle
missions.subtitle: Plan an adventure together
missions.guide: Read the clue. Tap the suggestion or reply that matches the plan!
missions.reminder: Let's suggests a plan. Good idea agrees. I'm not sure means you have not decided.

tasks.prompt: We have sand and a bucket. Choose the activity that uses both: Let's ___.
tasks.hint: Think about what you can make with sand and a bucket.
tasks.explain: Let's make a sandcastle matches the materials in the clue.

tasks.prompt: Paper and paints are ready. Choose the matching suggestion: Let's ___.
tasks.hint: Which activity uses paper and paints?
tasks.explain: Let's paint a picture matches the materials that are ready.

tasks.prompt: Your friend says, Let's go swimming. You want to swim too. Choose your reply: ___
tasks.hint: You both want to swim. Choose the reply that agrees.
tasks.explain: Good idea tells your friend that you want to follow the plan.

tasks.prompt: Your friend says, Let's play tennis. You do not want to play. Choose your reply: ___
tasks.hint: You have decided that you do not want to play.
tasks.explain: Sorry, I don't want to politely declines the tennis plan.

tasks.prompt: Your friend says, Let's read a book. You have not decided if you want to read. Choose your reply: ___
tasks.hint: Choose the reply that means you have not decided.
tasks.explain: I'm not sure tells your friend that you have not decided.

rules: shop
Check the supplies
There is ... · There are ... · How many ...?
Read the count. Use is for one and are for two or more. Ask How many? for a number.
How many hats are there? There are three hats.
bridge
Check the routine
Do you ...? · Yes, I do. · No, I don't.
Read the activity and the day. Match your reply to both.
Do you watch TV on Fridays? Yes, I do.
train
Tell your weekly plan
on Mondays · at the weekend
Put the activity after I. Use on with a day and at in at the weekend.
I play the piano on Saturdays.
boat
Describe or check clothes
She is wearing ... · Is she wearing ...?
A statement tells us about clothes. A question asks someone to check them.
Is he wearing a blue T-shirt?
pickaxe
Check an ability
Can you ...? · Yes, I can. · No, I can't.
Read the activity in the question. A friend may be able to do one activity but not another.
Can you skip? No, I can't.
portal
Check one item or more
this cap · these socks · Is he wearing ...?
Use this for one and these for more than one. Check the colour before replying.
Is he wearing a red cap? Yes, he is.
cat
Match the item and place
Where's / It's · Where are / They're
Find the correct item. Then match one or more and its place.
Where's the map? It's in the bag.
castle
Match a plan and a reply
Let's ... · Good idea. · I'm not sure.
Agree with Good idea. Say I'm not sure if you have not decided. Decline politely with Sorry, I don't want to.
Let's take a photo. Good idea.
